name: Pure Necrosis
description: A creature that touches the xeg-yi takes 9 (1d6 + 6) necrotic damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the xeg-yi corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the xeg-yi is destroyed after dealing damage.
